description: Set layer switches and timing: name, comment, enabled (video), audio, solo, shy, lock, 3D, motion blur, adjustment layer, effects (Effect switch), Collapse Transformations / Continuously Rasterize, Preserve Underlying Transparency, quality and sampling (Bilinear, Bicubic), blending mode (or step to the next or previous one), Auto-Orient, label, in and out points, start time, stretch

autoOrient.description: Layer > Transform > Auto-Orient: off, along_path, towards_camera (3D layers; cameras and lights toward their point of interest), characters_toward_camera (3D text)

collapseTransformation.description: Collapse Transformations (pre-compositions) or Continuously Rasterize (vector layers)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

cycleBlendingMode.description: Step to the next or previous blending mode in the menu (Shift+= and Shift+-)

effectsActive.description: Effect switch: render the layer's effects

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

sampling.description: Layer > Quality sampling at Best quality

name: set_layer_properties
title: Set Layer Properties
